name: idea.drop
description: Drops an idea: a skipped suggestion, or an idea let go. It leaves every shoot, and a planned shoot left with no idea goes too. One that is a post is refused: unplan it first.
sql:
with pruned as (
  delete from brandbase.shoots s
  where s.brand_id = :brand and s.origin = 'planned' and cardinality(array_remove(s.idea_ids, :id)) = 0
    and (:id = any (s.idea_ids) or cardinality(s.idea_ids) = 0)
  returning s.id
),
taken as (
  update brandbase.shoots s set idea_ids = array_remove(s.idea_ids, :id), version = s.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  where s.brand_id = :brand and :id = any (s.idea_ids) and s.id not in (select id from pruned)
  returning s.id
),
gone as (delete from brandbase.ideas i where i.id = :id and i.brand_id = :brand returning i.id)
select jsonb_build_object('deleted', g.id) as result from gone g
